_meta.method: Platform fetch_page reads of each canonical Amazon listing, returned page title and category breadcrumb in chunk 0 only; compared against products.json and products-extra.json. Re-read Operating Agreement chunks 0 and 1, Program Policies chunk 0, FTC Disclosures 101, GitHub Pages overview, Google spam-policy excerpts. No login, scraped reviews, copied listing images, prices or ratings.
_meta.result_summary: Nine of ten title/breadcrumb comparisons match the stored records. P2 title differs after its first segment, as already recorded under F-44. The same returned title and breadcrumb strings as the 2026-11-19 session were independently read again on 2026-11-20. No underlying product value was changed.
not_done: No short-link resolution in this pass; intent and observed redirects remain separate in data/intent-links.json.
No fresh dimensions/capacity/function/brand field checks beyond title wording; do not interpret this limited re-read as a full spec or performance verification.
No Associates enrollment/tag validation, one-link report test, API authorization, live analytics endpoint, Search Console queries, purchase/revenue data or legal compliance certification.
